# GitHub Copilot instructions

Read the root AGENTS.md and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md before implementing an assigned task. Follow the issue acceptance criteria and keep changes scoped to that issue.

This is a public-facing, database-free school website template built with Next.js App Router, TypeScript and CSS. It is not a student information system.

- Centralize school content in data/school.ts and sample notices in data/notices.ts.
- Follow the navy, gold and ivory design system in app/globals.css.
- Reuse components under components/ and use accessible, responsive HTML.
- Never invent real school credentials, affiliations, results, contact data or announcements.
- The contact form is a disabled preview. Never fake successful submission.
- Do not add a database, secrets, authentication, payment handling or student personal data without an explicitly reviewed issue.
- Avoid unnecessary dependencies and broad rewrites.
- Run npm run lint, npm run typecheck and npm run build when possible.
- Report test results honestly and mention anything not tested.
